Key: # The people of Oak Hill who give quests (2026-11-18). Quests.csv and QuestsSteps.csv name them by Key; never change a Key that a quest uses.
# Anchor: where they stand is measured from: plaza (the big oak in the middle of Oak Hill)
Name: or a shop's counter: smith
East: metres from the anchor (negative for south and west). Facing: degrees (0 north
Facing: or "oak" to face the plaza's oak.

Key: # If something stands where they would (a cart
Name: a barrel)
Anchor: they step up to 3 m aside
North: the same way on every machine.

Name: Hair: red green blue (0 to 1). Hat: none
Facing: cowl or feather. Apron: yes or no. Scale: 1 a grown-up

Key: # Greeting: what they say when they have nothing else to talk about
Name: one line picked each visit ("|" between the choices).
Marta Fernside, Steward
Greeting: Oak Hill has little, but we share it.|Mind the roots on the road, love.|Others have gold. We have each other. I know which I'd rather.

Name: Pell, the Smith's Lad
Greeting: The forge is warmer than it was. That's your doing.|Hammer, heat, hammer. That's the whole trick, really.|Master Hobb left for better coin. I'd rather stay poor and stay home.

Name: Nan Bramble, Baker
Greeting: Flour's dear since the mill changed hands. We make do.|There's always a heel of bread for a friend.|Wipe your boots, dear.

Name: Captain Corin of the Watch
Greeting: Three of us keep the watch. Three, and a dog who sleeps.|The river's quiet tonight. I don't trust it.|Some towns burn their lights all night. Ours we save for when they're needed.

Name: Wil Thatch
Greeting: Gran says the woods remember everything.|Did you know foxes laugh? They do. I heard one.|When I'm big I'm going to be a knight. A nice one.

Name: Hazel Fernwick, Broom-Maker
Greeting: A good broom chooses its rider, they say. Nonsense. You choose the broom.|Mind the bristles, dear.|In my day we flew to market and back before breakfast.

Name: Bram Holloway, Stablemaster
Greeting: A horse knows a kind hand.|Hay, water, and a good brush. That's all they ask.|Tap T and she comes. Hold it and she follows.
